species.description: Low many-stemmed silver trunk with a spreading rounded sage crown.
Bent pale trunks and a broad windswept yellow-green crown with light snow.
Tall white trunk with a loose light silvery green crown and open lower branches.
Compact cool green oval crown above several silver-grey trunks.
Low wide dark green lobed crown on visibly branching warm grey stems.
Upright broad oval blue-green crown on a straight dark trunk.
Slender pale trunk and a rounded muted golden crown with large leaf masses.
Low spreading silvery sage crown above an open forked cool brown trunk.
Broad rounded grey-green crown on a stout branching pale trunk, sparse snow.

job.prompt:
Production asset: exactly NINE different isolated individual trees in a transparent3x3 equal-cell sprite atlas, row-major order. Match the supplied approved game artwork in palette, camera, shading and painterly material treatment.
Fixed orthographic2:1 dimetric game camera; ground axes at+26.565/-26.565 degrees, no perspective convergence. Northwest daylight, restrained warm hand-painted miniature style. Full crowns, trunks, roots and a tiny soft contact shadow are visible.
Shared physical scale with game buildings: one ground tile is16m square, an adult is1.75m and a door is2.1m. Do not draw people, doors or buildings. The normalized256px cell uses13.15px per vertical metre. Tree heights vary naturally; do not enlarge shorter species to fill their cells.
Every tree root meets the shared horizontal baseline at95.5% of its cell height, centred horizontally. Crown and all branches stay inside their own cell with generous transparent gutters. Keep side gutters at least12% of cell width and top gutters at least10%. Tiny contact shadows fade out before the cell bottom. No long baked directional shadow; the game supplies the projected ground shadow.
Broad asymmetrical foliage masses and clear species silhouettes readable at Region and Town zoom. A few large boughs and trunk forks; no individual leaves, fine needle lines, stippling, scratches, tiny bark fissures, tiny fruit dots, lettering or botanical labels. Each requested species has distinct branch architecture and crown proportions.
Genuine transparent RGBA background; no coloured backdrop, checkerboard, ground rectangle, floating plinth, pots, frame, labels or UI. Exactly one whole tree per cell; no forest groups.
Cold northern woodland: cool sage and blue-green, pale bark, restrained ivory snow on upper branches and at roots. Keep tree anatomy visible.
Slot 1: arctic-birch, 7m tall, 92.0px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Low many-stemmed silver trunk with a spreading rounded sage crown.
Slot 2: mountain-birch, 10m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Bent pale trunks and a broad windswept yellow-green crown with light snow.
Slot 3: silver-birch, 14m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Tall white trunk with a loose light silvery green crown and open lower branches.
Slot 4: grey-alder, 11m tall, 144.6px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Compact cool green oval crown above several silver-grey trunks.
Slot 5: green-alder, 8m tall, 105.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Low wide dark green lobed crown on visibly branching warm grey stems.
Slot 6: balsam-poplar, 14m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Upright broad oval blue-green crown on a straight dark trunk.
Slot 7: quaking-aspen, 13m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Slender pale trunk and a rounded muted golden crown with large leaf masses.
Slot 8: feltleaf-willow, 8m tall, 105.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Low spreading silvery sage crown above an open forked cool brown trunk.
Slot 9: goat-willow, 10m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Broad rounded grey-green crown on a stout branching pale trunk, sparse snow.
